entities.summary: Bijan Kamkar (b. 1949, Sanandaj) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sanandaj and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, composers & musicians, asia.
